t: Good morning, everyone! I do hope you had a rather lovely weekend.
Would you care for a cup of tea, or perhaps a few biscuits?
Excuse me, could you kindly tell me the way to the railway station?
My name is Popo, and I absolutely adore learning English with you.
It is frightfully chilly today, is it not? Do remember your umbrella.
Thank you ever so much. It has been a genuine pleasure to meet you.
